human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Expose the package import service through a small CLI command for dogfooding and automation. It accepts one package directory, validates/imports it, prints machine-readable status when requested, and does not project/report in the same transaction. Dependency: 8007.add-idempotent-evidence-import.
human_pressure.why_now: EverRun dogfood packages need a stable ingestion entry point before cross-run processing.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add a narrow CLI command for importing one evidence package into the configured Ailuros SQLite store.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8007.add-idempotent-evidence-import. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Import and projection remain separable phases.
contracts: Input is an Ailuros evidence package directory.
failure_semantics: Missing package/invalid package is an explicit input failure, not a runtime governance block.

steps.title: Return clear statuses
details: JSON output includes run_id and event counts.

steps.title: Set exit codes
details: Invalid/conflict exit nonzero unless contract explicitly marks a tolerated state.

acceptance: CLI imports one package into selected DB.
Repeat import is visible as already-present and remains exit 0.
Invalid/conflicting package is nonzero and actionable.
CLI does not generate projection/report as hidden side effect.

reject_if: CLI hides validation conflict and exits success.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
